decoration: moderate — a few SVG blobs or grid lines
hero_headline_scale: mixed — huge first name, smaller subtitle underneath
hero_height: auto — natural content height, no forced height
nav_style: inline in hero — no separate nav bar, links inside hero
card_style: terminal window styled cards (title bar with dots)
scroll_animation: playful — elements slide/bounce in from different directions
hover_effects: moderate — scale, shadow change, color transitions
contact_style: split layout — message on left, links on right
border_radius: pill — fully rounded on small elements
bonus_quirk: footer includes a tiny randomly chosen emoji that changes daily
